## **WITH YOU ALL THE WAY**

* * *

We lead Seed, Series A, and Series B rounds—with initial investments of $500K to $15M+ and the ability to invest $25M+ over time.

- Business Technology
















We invest in technology companies addressing business needs — including software applications, IT infrastructure, developer tools and platforms, hardware, and other tech-driven products and services. We seek entrepreneurs and companies passionate about solving billion-dollar business problems in unique and transformative ways.

- Healthcare Technology
















We invest in companies improving the human condition through the development of medical devices and software. We seek entrepreneurs with a passion to challenge the status quo in diagnosis, treatment and wellness—from mobile applications to surgical innovations to data-driven software solutions.
